notes.title: Roguefall Demo 0.2.0 Release
notes.notes:
It's been sometime since our last post, but we're proud to finally bring you a major update to Roguefall.

We've overhauled quite a few things so lets get started:

Gathering
You can now find different resources to gather throughout the Grassy Grove. Here are some rocks:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482090/948449284fafbc07078ce7cf324023ab8f2b1746.png"]In boxes you can find these mysterious Essences:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482090/41613c6b73cf7a892a9003939e129405b517b323.png"]Here you can see a harmless chicken, surely you wouldn't kill it just for some feathers?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482090/c64f854491898f89ac0feb43fdf928caa8691faa.png"]But of course there are many more resources to gather!

Crafting

Using the previously mentioned resources you can modify the newly added item called Treasures.
Treasures are found throughout your run and give boosts to different stats. You can change which stats are boosted using the Crafting Table. Here's a preview of the crafting:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482090/f923639126d5b6fd92e2bc0f1f1e3bf9f371feae.png"]Hop in yourself to discover all materials and craft powerful Treasures!

Antique Firearm

We've added a new weapon, the Antique Firearm. It is a ranged weapon which deals a significant amount of damage, but has to be reloaded after four shots:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482090/89c2e67c532d20c9a3e9aab761757014925dc232.png"]

Mysterious Scythe

The Mysterious Scythe is a new weapon with which you can summon fallen foes to fight for you!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482090/2219213d8452e08c42be669bf41c2bcfa7cde990.png"]

Level System

Maybe you've already noticed a few bars on the lower end of the previous screenshots. These indicate your XP which you can spend to boost your stats:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482090/f8deb33f84c04428e41df83cf85df21fb36c1bca.png"]

Layer Layout
As we announced in a previous post, rooms are now on a grid that you can explore using a minimap. The layout is randomly generated for each run. Here is an example:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482090/55486ca0afff08584921966c1da9c8f4c32ced2f.png"]There are different rooms to discover on the map, each with different enemies and rewards.

Echoes

Echoes are passives that change a part of the game in a more significant way than simple stats will. Here are a few of them:
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482090/dceb40187c4592c97201fba21e1708a9515a7412.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482090/fff0543cdac4ba87e951a4ccb064572b81bf243c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482090/cee895c37c5f48880e7411343e1bc5e1afcc04fc.png"][/carousel]
However, in the future we will be moving these effects to Unique Treasures, as we think they fit better into that category. More on those in a future update.

Meta Progression

Unfortunately we couldn't overhaul the meta progression in time so we will be doing that in a future update. Stay tuned!

We've also added another type of item which we mentioned in our last post. Hop in game to find it!

That's all for now and check back for more updates in the future!

notes.title: Changelog: Roguefall Demo Patch 0.1.5
notes.notes:
We have added a V-Sync option in the menu. By default it is turned on.
This should alleviate performance issues users were having due to the frames per second being uncapped.

Later on we plan on adding a option to set the target frame rate in case you do not want to use V-Sync.
